# A Comparison of Binary Classification with Linear SVM and Multi-class Prediction
## Loading models and running them on testing data
```{r, echo = FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(e1071)
library(yardstick)
library(randomForest)
library(tidymodels)
source("../scripts/preprocessing.R")
```

Loading models
```{r}
load("../data/test-train-multi-class.RData")
bclass_svm_model <- get(load("../results/svm-binary-model.RData"))
mclass_rf_fit <- get(load("../results/multi-class-model.RData"))
```

Setting up test data
```{r}
test_x <- test_text %>%
  select(-.id, -mclass, -bclass)

test_yb <- factor(test_text$bclass)
test_ym <- factor(test_text$mclass)
```

Running models on test data
```{r}
bclass_svm_model_predictions <- predict(bclass_svm_model, test_x, decision.values = TRUE)
prob_bclass <- attr(bclass_svm_model_predictions, 'decision.values')

mclass_rf_fit_predictions <- predict(mclass_rf_fit, test_x, type = 'prob')
mclass_rf_fit_predictions2 <- predict(mclass_rf_fit, test_x)

#since everything is already sorted by index this can be done without the need for an inner join
model_results <- data.frame(claim_binary = test_yb, binary_class_prediction = bclass_svm_model_predictions, probs = prob_bclass, claim_multi = test_ym, multi_class_prediction = mclass_rf_fit_predictions2) 
model_results <- bind_cols(model_results, mclass_rf_fit_predictions)
colnames(model_results) <- c("claim_binary", "binary_class_prediction", 
                             "binary_decision_values", "claim_multi", 
                             "multi_class_prediction", "prob_No_relevant_content", 
                             "prob_physical_activity", "prob_possible_fatality", 
                             "prob_potentially_unlawful_activity", "prob_other_claim_content")
head(model_results, 20)
save(model_results, file = "../results/model-evaluations/model-results-comparison.RData")
```

## Evaluating Binary Classification on sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and roc_auc
```{r}
bclass_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, 
                             sensitivity, 
                             specificity, 
                             roc_auc)
bclass_output_results <- model_results %>%
    mutate(estimate = factor(binary_class_prediction == "Relevant claim content", 
                             levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)),
           truth = factor(claim_binary == "Relevant claim content", 
                          levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))) %>%
    bclass_metrics(estimate = estimate,
                   truth = truth, binary_decision_values,
                   event_level = 'second')
```

## Evaluating Multi-class Prediction on sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and roc_auc
```{r}
mclass_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy,
                             yardstick::sens, 
                             yardstick::spec, 
                             roc_auc)
mclass_output_results <- model_results %>%
    mutate(estimate = factor(multi_class_prediction),
           truth = factor(claim_multi)) %>%
    mclass_metrics(estimate = estimate,
                   truth = truth, 
                   prob_No_relevant_content, 
                   prob_physical_activity,
                   prob_possible_fatality,
                   prob_potentially_unlawful_activity,
                   prob_other_claim_content) %>%
    mutate(.metric = case_when(.metric == "sens" ~ "sensitivity",
                               .metric == "spec" ~ "specificity",
                               TRUE ~ .metric))
```

```{r}
model_evaluation <- cbind.data.frame(data.frame(Model = c("Binary Model (support vector machine)", 
                                                          "Binary Model (support vector machine)", 
                                                          "Binary Model (support vector machine)", 
                                                          "Binary Model (support vector machine)",
                                                          "Multi-class Model (random forest)",
                                                          "Multi-class Model (random forest)",
                                                          "Multi-class Model (random forest)",
                                                          "Multi-class Model (random forest)")),
                                     rbind.data.frame(bclass_output_results, 
                                                      mclass_output_results))
colnames(model_evaluation) <- c("Model", "Metric", "Estimator", "Estimate Value")
model_evaluation
save(model_evaluation, file = "../results/model-evaluations/model-evaluations.RData")
```
